text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Here, have some carrots... You 
can take as many as you want from the box 
right now, waaaah... Uuuughhh...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, what's going on? Why is Spe handing 
out carrots...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Mom sent me some carrots yesterday. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm cutting weight for my race right 
now... so I can't eat it... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you over there with black hair... 
please have a carrot... It's packed with 
nutrients... looks delicious... uuu...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, please, no more...! Holding it in is 
bad for your health!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I know a few healthy recipes! May I 
prepare something for you with those 
carrots?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-Healthy food...!! If it's that... no, 
but... ... Uuuughh!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer!! What should I do?!
choice_data_list: If it's healthy, it's safe to eat!
How about we split it among everyone?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right! If it's healthy, then eating 
it is totally fine, right?! ...Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why, Cesario-san, could we 
count on you?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ With pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Special Week's eyes sparkled 
at the sight of a mountain of food nearly 
overflowing from the cafeteria table.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So many...! That must have been quite an 
ordeal, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. Buena-san helped me out, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
When I heard it was for you, Spe-san, I 
just couldn't sit still. Please, help 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, thank you both so much! Well then, 
right away...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!! The omelet rice is so fluffy and 
runny! Is this really healthy!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I bulked up the eggs with tofu, and 
swapped about half the rice for carrots."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Carrot gratin... and it's healthy too!? 
This is wickedly good, you betcha~~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! I used chopped konjac 
instead of macaroni, after all."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew~~~~! I'm sooooo full!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooo much! Once the race is 
over, please let me repay you two!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to...! But thank 
you so much! We did it, Cesario-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Your support makes me so happy, 
Spe-san♪ Good luck in your race too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's so true! If we share, it's half 
the calories and twice the happiness!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: In that case, I have a splendid idea♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Here's your special 
okonomiyaki with plenty of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waah, it smells so fragrant and nice...! 
Thank you so much! Please, take that seat 
over there.
choice_data_list:
I see. So you're gathering more people to 
eat with.

I see. So you're gathering more people to 
eat with.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. One-third the portion, three times 
the happiness— this should be so much 
better!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please eat some with me too, Trainer! Then 
that one-quarter will become quadruple the 
fun!
choice_data_list: Well then, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was delicious! Both my body 
and soul are completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely stuffed too. Eating 
together just makes it so much more 
satisfying!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The carrots were packed with sweetness and 
so delicious. Could you please pass along 
my thanks to your mother?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll write a letter telling 
them we all ate together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san, Buena-san, thank you both so 
much for helping with the cooking and 
eating!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm just glad you liked it♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, powered by carrots, I'm gonna 
give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuu............ You're ride............ I 
hab to sdik wid it and not led my guard 
down until de very end...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Spe-san......

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine, Cesario! In fact, you being 
so blunt really fired me up! It's just..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'll give in to temptation if 
it's right in front of me, so could you 
please take this carrot?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh? But it's Spe-san's favorite food...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! We had a great harvest this 
year, so I'm sure they'll send more. 
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The carrots my mom sends me are super 
duper sweet and delicious, so I really 
wanted you to try some too, Cesario-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you can't finish it all, you can share 
it with everyone in the dorm...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Then I will accept the 
carrots. Please let me tell you what I 
thought of the taste next time!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why Cesario-chan was 
handing out carrots.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san is amazing. I really look up to 
her!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I understand. It's really tough holding 
back on your favorite food.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
*chomp*, mmm............ Whoa! Were 
carrots always this sweet? It's 
delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're right! My cheeks are practically 
gonna melt off♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's treat Spe-san to some of this 
once the race is over. I'm sure she'll 
love it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, great idea! Let's treat them to a 
whole feast of delicious carrot dishes♪
